observations.command:
uname -a
cat /proc/version
ls /sys/module | grep -Ei 'sdp|tcon|pqe|display|drm|frc'
find /sys/module -maxdepth 3 -type f -path '*/parameters/*' | grep -Ei 'tcon|panel|display|pqe|frc|saver' | head -n 100
find /sys/kernel/debug -maxdepth 2 -iname '*tcon*' -o -iname '*panel*' -o -iname '*display*' -o -iname '*pqe*' -o -iname '*frc*' 2>/dev/null | head -n 100
awk '{print $3}' /proc/kallsyms | grep -Ei 'QDFTcon.*(Error|Fault|Power|Monitor|SsBright|OffSens)|display.*lock|tcon.*(errdet|recovery)' | head -n 100
